{{Quote|Your friend is a Separatist? One of Dooku's ''pawns''?''"<br />"''The Separatists used to be a part of the Republic. I was close with many of the senators who left. I may not agree with them, but they're more than pawns.|Ahsoka Tano and Padmé Amidala, on Senator Mina Bonteri of the Separatist Parliament|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />}}
The '''Separatist Senate''', also known as the '''Separatist Parliament''' or the '''Separatist Congress''', was the civilian legislature that governed the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], representing thousands of its member [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When the charismatic [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] [[Raxus Address/Legends|founded]] the Confederacy in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], the swaths of [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] and [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] seceding from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] formed their own congressional assembly to oversee the Separatist state. A number of the appointed [[Senator/Legends|delegates]], having served as members of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]] prior to their secession, continued to represent their constituents in the Confederacy. Operating by a bill of rights known as the [[Bylaws of Independent Systems/Legends|Bylaws of Independent Systems]], the Parliament was headed by the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], Dooku, as well as by [[Separatist Congress Leader/Legends|Separatist Congress Leader]] [[Bec Lawise/Legends|Bec Lawise]]. It became headquartered on the Separatist [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]], where sessions were held in the [[Separatist Senate Building/Legends|Separatist Senate Building]].

Although the representative voices of the Parliament gained a role in state matters, various elements of the Separatist hierarchy often rendered them ineffective. The corporate interests on the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] also made governmental decisions, and Dooku himself&mdash;who was secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Tyranus&mdash;manipulated situations to ensure that pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] war continued for the [[Grand Plan/Legends|purposes]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. At [[Time/Legends|times]] maneuvers on the part of other war-profiteering parties negated legislation that the Parliament had enacted; some came to see the assembly's members as Dooku's pawns. Furthermore, the senators of the Parliament as well as the citizens of the Confederacy were repeatedly shielded from front-line reports of brutal campaigns waged by such [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] as [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Ultimately, the Confederacy was regarded more as a movement instead of a centralized government, in spite of the Parliament's involvement in public affairs.

A wide range of views comprised the Parliament, leading to a division of positions about maintaining the war effort against the Republic. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], after the Clone Wars had been raging for over a [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Senator [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], in collaboration with Republic Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], introduced a [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|bill]] to open peace negotiations with the Republic. Her bill passed in session by a majority, and the Parliament's motion for peace was extended to the Republic Senate. Yet Dooku conspired with a group of war profiteers to ensure that the Republic rejected the offer, culminating with his orchestration of Bonteri's [[Attack on Confederate people/Legends|murder]] and the withdrawal of the proposal. A delegation later represented the Parliament at an unprecedented [[Confederate–Republic peace conference/Legends|peace conference]] with Republic congresspeople on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], but the talks similarly failed. The Confederacy was dissolved in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] with the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|death]] of Dooku and the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|execution]] of the Separatist Council, ending the Clone Wars.

==Description==
===Organization===
{{Quote|In accordance with the Bylaws of Independent Systems, a voice vote is required.|Count Dooku|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />}}
[[File:TheAyesHaveIt-HOBS.png|thumb|left|250px|The Head of State presided over Parliament sessions with the Separatist Congress Leader.]]
The Separatist Parliament,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> alternatively becoming known as the Separatist Senate<ref name="Supply Lines">{{TCW|Supply Lines}}</ref> or the Separatist Congress, was a ruling body established to oversee affairs of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Comprising [[Senator/Legends|delegates]] speaking for<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> thousands of the Confederacy's member [[Planet/Legends|worlds]],<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Dataclip">{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250ab02c325aa5012c51f9e2db0273|text=Dataclip: Heroes on Both Sides|na=video file}}</ref> the Parliament was presided over by a [[Separatist Congress Leader/Legends|Separatist Congress Leader]],<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> who was tasked with being the body's speaker.<ref name="Explore: Crisis at the Heart">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/crisis-at-the-heart-episode-guide|text="Crisis at the Heart" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref> The Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], serving as the leader of the Senate, was also allowed to officiate at sessions.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> In addition to member worlds,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Dataclip" /> corporations such as the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] were granted representation, becoming a part of the legislature's decision-making. While in session, individual congresspeople could propose legislation, which required a majority vote to be enacted into law. A bill of rights, the [[Bylaws of Independent Systems/Legends|Bylaws of Independent Systems]], dictated operational procedures for the Parliament; for example, a voice vote was to be taken for matters such as opening peace negotiations with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />

The Parliament was viewed primarily as a civilian [[Politics/Legends|political]] branch of the Confederacy's government, more so than<ref name="Supply Lines Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode303.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Supply Lines}}</ref> another Confederate ruling body, the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]].<ref name="CSWE: Separatist Council">{{CSWECite|III|139|Separatist Council}}</ref> Comprising solely corporate leaders who funded the Separatist war machine,<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> the Council also made governmental decisions for the Confederacy, in addition to managing the war effort and overseeing the distribution of assets to member worlds.<ref name="Insider 72: Shadowfeed">{{InsiderCite|72|CIS Shadowfeed Year's Start Fete Day Edition}}</ref>

===The Separatist hierarchy===
{{Quote|No! Dooku is deceiving you. You will all be betrayed, just like my mother.|Lux Bonteri, to several senators of the Separatist Parliament|<ref name="A Friend in Need">{{TCW|A Friend in Need}}</ref>}}
[[File:SepCouncilUtapau-ROTS.png|thumb|right|250px|Elements of the Separatist hierarchy often undermined Parliament legislation.]]
Controversy surrounded the efficacy of the Separatist Parliament during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the Confederacy was engulfed in full-scale war with the Galactic Republic. As a separatist government, the Confederacy consisted of [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] and [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] seceding from the Republic as well as megacorporations and [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] cartels such as the Corporate Alliance, [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], and [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], among others.<ref name="Warfare" /> These conglomerates were represented on the Separatist Council, which existed alongside the civilian-based Parliament.<ref name="Supply Lines Ep Guide" /><ref name="ROTS" /> With the wide reach of philosophies, some political and others corporate-driven, the Separatists fell into more of a hierarchy than a formal, centralized government. Such was the framework of the Confederacy that at times the Parliament's decrees were ignored, manipulated, or made ineffectual.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /><ref name="Warfare" /> [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] himself, Head of State of the Confederacy, had a hand in invalidating Parliament legislation as part of schemes that<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> the [[Order of the Sith Lords]] concocted.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Senator [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] believed that Dooku would betray the members of the Parliament if his machinations warranted such expedience.<ref name="A Friend in Need" />

Separatist delegates who were affiliated with companies like the Corporate Alliance garnered criticism for perpetuating corporate voices in political affairs, as was the case in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> Yet those same [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] enterprises were the cornerstone of the Confederacy, as their security forces constituted the [[Confederacy military/Legends|Confederacy military]], particularly the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Furthermore, Parliament members as well as Separatist citizens were constantly kept in the dark about the exploits and onslaughts of ruthless military [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] such as [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. This conduct resulted in an incomplete view of the Separatists' presence in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] war theater, creating further problems for the Parliament.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mina">{{SWE|characters|minabonteri|Mina Bonteri}}</ref> Some individuals on the side of the Republic saw the Separatist senators as pawns of Dooku,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> while the Parliament itself was widely considered abortive due to the formation of the Separatist hierarchy.<ref name="Warfare" />

==History==
===Formation===
{{Quote|The Republic Senate is holding a critical vote on whether or not to escalate the war effort. However, many of the delegates are undecided as to what to do.''"<br />"''How interesting. You would find the Separatist Parliament in a similar dilemma.|Padmé Amidala and Mina Bonteri|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />}}
[[File:SeparatistSenate2-HOBS.png|thumb|left|250px|The Separatist Parliament spoke for thousands of Confederate member worlds.]]
The Confederacy of Independent Systems was founded in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], when the charismatic [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku, a former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], delivered fiery rhetoric that criticized the Republic Senate of corruption, with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] guilty for supporting such a regime<ref name="HoloNet: Dooku Spotted">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|54|news/1352_1.html|Dooku Spotted in Gree Enclave}}</ref> that was beyond saving.<ref name="Attack of the Clones novel">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> The [[Raxus Address/Legends|Raxus Address]], as his speech was dubbed, established the Confederacy as a separatist state from the Republic.<ref name="Warfare" /> Thousands of sectors and [[Star/Legends|star]] systems began issuing [[Articles of Secession/Legends|Articles of Secession]] to the Republic,<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="HoloNet: Abrion Secedes">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|news/13418_1.html|Abrion Sector Secedes; Separatists Get Agri-Worlds}}</ref> flocking to the Confederacy alongside megacorporations including the Trade Federation, InterGalactic Banking Clan, Corporate Alliance, [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], and others seeking Dooku's promise of free trade.<ref name="Attack of the Clones novel" /> In reality, the Confederacy was created to secretly serve the [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]] of the Order of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lords]], of which Dooku was a member under the alter ego of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Tyranus. While Tyranus led the Confederacy into war with the Republic, the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]&mdash;in his guise as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine of the Republic&mdash;would destabilize the Republic so that the Sith could eventually claim absolute power over the galaxy. The Confederacy was thus a sham, the result of Sith plotting against the Republic.<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

Over six thousand worlds joined the Confederacy during the period of tensions termed the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], which lasted from 24 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> The InterGalactic Banking Clan, Trade Federation, and their fellow Separatist-loyal companies officially signed on to the cause in 22 BBY, pledging their financial support<ref name="Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> as well as their standing security forces to the Confederate military. When the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] erupted that year, the corporations' various [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] security forces, eventually organized as the Separatist [[Droid/Legends|Droid]] [[Army/Legends|Army]], were deployed against the newly-created [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Warfare" /> Pan-galactic conflict broke out following the Battle of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] in what would become known as the Clone Wars.<ref name="NEC" />

While the Separatist Council was formed from the corporate leaders overseeing the war effort,<ref name="CSWE: Separatist Council" /> another ruling body was established from the civilian populace. The Separatist Parliament, as it came to be known, comprised representatives from thousands of Separatist member worlds,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Dataclip" /> comparative to the makeup of the Republic Senate. Indeed, a number of the senators who were appointed to the Parliament were former members of the Republic Senate, such as [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]],<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> who continued to represent her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in the Confederacy.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mina" /> Senator [[Bec Lawise/Legends|Bec Lawise]] became the Separatist Congress Leader,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> presiding over Parliament sessions alongside Confederate Head of State Dooku. The assembly was headquartered on<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> the Separatist [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Dataclip" /> of [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]],<ref name="TCWEG" /> which was [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] by a sizable [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] from the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> The [[Separatist Senate Building/Legends|Separatist Senate Building]]<ref name="Explore: Heroes on Both Sides" /> was installed at the center of a [[Unidentified Raxus Secundus city|large city]] on Raxus Secundus with an upper viewing gallery for observers.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />

The Parliament faced many challenges during the Clone Wars, including justifying the very existence of the Confederacy. In spite of a number of attempts to negotiate with the Separatists, the Republic Senate refused to acknowledge the legitimacy of the Separatist state, going so far as to pass a [[Republic Senate non-communication law/Legends|law]] prohibiting Republic senators from engaging in communication with Separatist officials.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> The Confederacy's appointed [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies]],<ref name="NEC" /> General Grievous, committed many exploits on the front lines, but the politicians and citizens of the Confederacy were kept unaware of his crimes<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mina" /> as well as other atrocities being performed in their name against the Republic.<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep414|text="A Friend in Need" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> Dooku and Darth Sidious were at the center of perpetuating conflict between the Republic and the Confederacy<ref name="NEC" /> so as to further the Sith Grand Plan to rule the galaxy.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

===A failed peace===
{{Quote|Your Republic forces have carried out a ''barbaric attack'' on our people, and among the deaths was the very ''sponsor'' of the peace accord, Senator Mina Bonteri. With her needless death, I must formally withdraw the proposal for peace offered by our Senate.|Count Dooku, in a transmission to the Republic Senate|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>}}
[[File:SeparatistSenate3-HOBS.png|thumb|right|250px|By Bluss and other Parliament senators applaud Mina Bonteri's calls for peace.]]
As the Separatist Droid Army gained ground on battlefronts across the galaxy, some Parliament senators campaigned to escalate the war effort against the Republic. Yet the majority of delegates had difficulty deciding if they should cast their support to further expansion of their armed forces. Similar conditions in the Republic Senate came to a head<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the second year of the war,<ref name="FF-2014 7: Katuunko">{{FactFile2014|7|KAT 1-2|King Katuunko}}</ref> and led Republic Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to journey to Raxus Secundus in violation of the Republic's non-contact statute. A vocal advocate for [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomacy]] amidst the increasing cacophony of the Republic Senate, Amidala was concerned about a [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|rising bill]] in her own Senate that would deregulate the galactic [[Bank/Legends|banks]], opening new lines of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] to expand the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] and thus increase the fighting. She traveled to Raxus Secundus with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to seek out a meeting with Mina Bonteri of Onderon, who had mentored her in politics during her early career, in the hopes of ending the war via diplomatic negotiations. In talks with her former colleague, Amidala convinced Bonteri that if the Separatist Parliament extended an olive branch of peace, there might be enough of a sympathetic response in the Republic Senate to begin formal intergovernmental dialogue. Bonteri agreed and promised to tender a motion for peace to the Parliament.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />

Bonteri drafted her [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|bill]], which would immediately sanction an offer for peace negotiations to Supreme Chancellor Palpatine and the Republic, and introduced it at a following Parliament session. She prefaced her proposal, to cries of support and rejection from all sides of the Separatist Senate Building, by decrying the futility of the war's casualties and calling for a peaceful coexistence between Confederate and Republic worlds. Once she had finished, numerous senators stood up to applaud her words, though other delegates did not agree. Among the dissenters was<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> Senator [[Voe Atell/Legends|Voe Atell]],<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> an affiliate of the Corporate Alliance, who asserted that the commerce guild would never allow the passage of such a proposal.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> Senator [[Kerch Kushi/Legends|Kerch Kushi]]<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> disputed her claims, citing the democratic system of the Parliament as well as its lack of corporate governance. Amidst the widespread debate that broke out after Kushi's statements, Count Dooku called for order so that Bonteri's bill could be brought to a vote. As per the Bylaws of Independent Systems, Dooku held a voice vote, with Senators Bonteri, Kushi,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> [[By Bluss/Legends|By Bluss]], and [[Amita Fonti/Legends|Amita Fonti]]<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> among the supporters. Voting nay were Atell,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> [[Punn Rimbaud/Legends|Punn Rimbaud]],<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> and a number of others, but they were ultimately outvoted.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />

Following the enactment of Bonteri's bill, Amidala returned with Tano to the Republic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Palpatine was skeptical of the Separatists' offer for peace given their past refusals for negotiation, but Amidala confidentially assured him of its sincerity because of its origination with Bonteri, allowing the vote to be brought to the Senate floor. No party was less alarmed by the Parliament's offer than the coalition pushing for Republic banking deregulation, consisting of Trade Federation Senator [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], InterGalactic Banking Clan lobbyist [[Nix Card/Legends|Nix Card]], and Senator [[Gume Saam/Legends|Gume Saam]],<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> the latter of whom was receiving payoffs from the Techno Union.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> All three profited from the war through their corporate affiliations and had already arranged&mdash;through their secret ties to Dooku&mdash;for an attack on Coruscant to panic the Senate into passing the deregulation legislation. On Dooku's orders, without Parliament authorization, Grievous had a team of<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid]]s<ref name="FF-2014 76: Demolition Droid">{{FactFile2014|76|BAT 21-22|Demolition droid}}</ref> [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] the [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|Coruscant power network]]. The assault coincided with the Republic Senate's vote on the bank reform bill, which had its intended effect. Reported as an act of Separatist [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]], the bombing of the [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] portrayed the Parliament's offer for peace as insincere and, much to Amidala's dismay, prompted the Senate to overwhelmingly vote in favor of banking deregulation.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> The Senate later rejected the Parliament's motion in light of the attack on Coruscant.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />

[[File:Dooku_no_peace_PoP.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Dooku formally withdraws the Parliament's offer for peace from the Republic Senate.]]
With negotiations with the Republic thwarted, Dooku swiftly engineered a [[Attack on Confederate people/Legends|secret attack]] on Confederate territory<ref name="FF-2014 56: Heroes">{{FactFile2014|56|20 BBY 5-8|Negotiation or militarisation?}}</ref> in which Sith [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] [[Death/Legends|murdered]] Bonteri,<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need" /><ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /><ref name="What Is a Sith Warrior?">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: What Is a Sith Warrior?]]''</ref> then publicly alleged that she had been killed in a Republic assault that had targeted the people of the Confederacy.<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> Rife with fear of attack,<ref name="FF-2014 56: Heroes" /> the Parliament withdrew Bonteri's peace proposal, with Dooku relaying that decision in a direct transmission to the Republic Senate. Although Republic [[Spy/Legends|spies]] uncovered evidence of Bonteri's assassination,<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> many Parliament members did not believe that their Head of State had executed their highly esteemed colleague or that he was even capable of such wrongdoing.<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> In any case, Dooku's actions ensured the collapse of Confederate&ndash;Republic diplomatic negotiations.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />

In the aftermath of the Republic Senate's deregulation of the banks,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> the Separatists took out a loan from the InterGalactic Banking Clan to finance the manufacture of three million additional battle droids for the Separatist Droid Army, even with an interest rate hike from ten to twenty-five percent.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> The Republic Senate soon responded by approving<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref><ref name="Chee Twitter Spending Bill">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/10941008766308352|[[Leland Chee]]|date=2010-12-03|quote=For those left wondering, we learned in Season 2 Senate Murders that the military spending increase passed anyway.|nolive=1}}</ref> an [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|order]] for five million new [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] for its Grand Army, guaranteeing that the Clone Wars would continue across the galaxy.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> Mina Bonteri's Parliament seat for Onderon was filled by her son, Lux Bonteri.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Lux">{{SWE|characters|luxbonteri|Lux Bonteri}}</ref>

===Conference on Mandalore===
{{Quote|The Republic recognizes the tragedy of war. But there is nothing we can change that has already occurred.''"<br />"''Say it aloud before this gathering, as representative for Chancellor Palpatine that you declare without reservation the Separatist State ''legitimate''.|Padmé Amidala and Voe Atell|<ref name="A Friend in Need" />}}
[[File:Peace_conference.png|thumb|right|250px|A Parliament delegation meets with Republic senators in an unprecedented peace conference.]]
The Parliament later agreed to send a delegation of senators to meet with Republic representatives in the first-ever [[Confederate–Republic peace conference/Legends|peace conference]] between the two states. The neutral world of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] was chosen as a meeting ground, with [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] hosting the gathering. Senators Voe Atell and Amita Fonti and Separatist Congress Leader Bec Lawise consented to represent the Parliament, meeting in the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|royal palace]] of the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] with Republic Senators Padmé Amidala, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]]<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]],<ref name="Encyclopedia: Organa">{{SWE|characters|bailorgana|Bail Organa}}</ref> and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]],<ref name="Clone Card: Mothma">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/tradingcards/cards/lg_monmothma.jpg|text=Clone Card: Mon Mothma|nobackup=1}}</ref> all of whom hoped for a peaceful end to the fighting.<ref name="Senate Murders" /> In accordance with [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] law, both delegations were to remain unarmed,<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need" /> though the Parliament senators' [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] were equipped with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] as [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]]. As soon as Amidala,<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> the leader of the Republic representatives,<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need" /> opened the conference, the Separatist delegation's first order of business was to address<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> an age-old issue<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> for the Confederacy: the legitimacy of the Separatist state. Speaking for her fellow delegates, Atell demanded that the Republic confer political recognition on the Confederacy, an act that Amidala and her colleagues hesitated to perform.<ref name="A Friend in Need" />

The proceedings were thereafter interrupted by Lux Bonteri, who had recently resigned from the Parliament and renounced his Separatist affiliations. The Parliament senators were nettled by Bonteri's uninvited presence, particularly when he took to the podium and publicly accused Dooku of complicity in his [[Parent/Legends|mother's]] homicide. Lawise ordered his security droids to arrest Bonteri and remove him from the royal palace. Although Kryze objected to the droids' handing of Bonteri, Atell cited the matter as an internal affair, blocking outside interference. Lawise apologized on the Separatists' behalf for the interruption and allowed the discussions to continue, though they ultimately failed to bear fruit. The deliberations broke down<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> due to shadowy interests on both sides,<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mothma">{{SWE|characters|mon-mothma|Mon Mothma}}</ref> with the Senate and Parliament delegations unable to negotiate an end the war. Further adding to the tensions was the discovery that Bonteri had escaped from custody aboard the Separatists' [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] at the [[Sundari shipping docks/Legends|Sundari docks]] with the aid of an old friend, Ahsoka Tano, who was serving as Amidala's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]]. Having pursued Tano and Bonteri to the Republic [[Transport/Legends|transports]], the Parliament's [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of security droids engaged in a [[Lightfight|firefight]] with the Republic's [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]], though they were unable to prevent Bonteri from escaping off-world with Tano.<ref name="A Friend in Need" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|19.1 BBY]], the final [[Standard month/Legends|month]] of the war,<ref name="Crisis at the Heart Date">{{FactFile2014|46|20 BBY 61-64|Banking Clan conspiracy}} dates "[[Crisis at the Heart]]" to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], while {{FactFile2014|23|PLO 1-6|Plo Koon}} dates "[[Sabotage (episode)|Sabotage]]" to the final [[Standard month/Legends|month]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes as 19.1 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. Since Since {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}} places "Crisis at the Heart" after "Sabotage," it can be concluded that "Crisis at the Heart" also takes place in 19.1 BBY.</ref> the Confederate government recognized a new head of the InterGalactic Banking Clan: [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]]. A Separatist delegation, headed by Bec Lawise, was allowed to attend the transfer of power at the Banking Clan's headquarters on the planet [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]]. The proceedings saw direct interference from Dooku, who&mdash;having aided Clovis's rise to power&mdash;engineered a plot to usurp control of the banks. On behalf of the Confederacy, Dooku refused to pay the interest on their loans from the Banking Clan, manipulating Clovis into instead raising the Republic's interest rates. Dooku then brought a Confederate [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] to Scipio, [[Invasion of Scipio/Legends|decimating]] the Republic's on-world security [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] in order to implicate Clovis in a partisan alliance with the Separatists. After Dooku arrested Padmé Amidala, the leader of the Republic delegation, Lawise voiced opposition to his scheme, as he believed that the Parliament would not approve so brazen a move. Dooku responded by using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] maneuver Amidala into gunning down Lawise. He then withdrew his naval armada from Scipio, leaving the Banking Clan in shambles and eventually leading to the Republic Senate transferring full control of the banks to Supreme Chancellor Palpatine.<ref name="Crisis at the Heart">{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}}</ref>

===War's end and legacy===
After three years of conflict, the Confederacy was defeated in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="NEC" /> with the death of Count Dooku at the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] and the following [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|execution]] of the Separatist Council on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. The Sith Grand Plan finally came to fruition: Palpatine [[Declaration of a New Order|reestablished]] the Republic as the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], with himself as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] for life.<ref name="ROTS" /> Without its corporate leadership, the Confederacy surrendered,<ref name="NEC" /> and a [[Master control signal|mass signal]] was transmitted from Mustafar to deactivate the Separatist Droid Army. Nevertheless, [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|holdout factions]] of unrepentant Separatists took several years for the new Empire to conquer and subjugate.<ref name="Warfare" />

The Parliament was remembered for its ultimate ineffectiveness in the Separatist hierarchy. When Senator Mon Mothma of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] became the [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after its [[Corellian Treaty|founding]]<ref name="Warfare" /> in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="TFUn">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref> she looked to the representative Parliament while organizing the Rebel Alliance. Given the uselessness of the Parliament, Mothma believed that treating the Rebellion as a Republic-in-[[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] would inevitably remind the galaxy of the Confederacy. Being a separate government, a Republic-in-exile would also give credence to the Empire as a legitimate state instead of a corruption of the Republic, as was intended. In the resulting [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Rebel Alliance succeeded in overthrowing the Empire, eventually [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|installing]] the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as the dominant galactic government.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Notable members==
===Count Dooku===
{{Quote|I sense Dooku's dirty hand in all of this."<br />"He's just the leader of the Senate. He's not the leader of the entire ''universe''.''"<br />"''Oh, I forgot. You actually ''admire'' the man.|Padmé Amidala and Mina Bonteri|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />}}
{{Main|Dooku/Legends}}
[[File:Dooku_CIS.png|thumb|right|150px|Count Dooku]]
The Head of State of the Confederacy, Dooku served as the leader of both the Separatist Parliament and the Separatist Council during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /><ref name="FF-2014 56: Heroes" /> Initially a Jedi Master, Dooku resigned from the Jedi Order in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], disputing its place in a corrupt Republic. While reclaiming his title of Count of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], he secretly became the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] to the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious, taking up the mantle of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Tyranus.<ref name="NEC" /> His duties in the Parliament included officiating over sessions and overseeing votes,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> usually doing so via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], as he was frequently prosecuting the war from a distance.<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need" />

Although he maintained the public persona of a charismatic and reasonable politician<ref name="What Is a Sith Warrior?" /><ref name="Encyclopedia: Dooku">{{SWE|characters|dooku|Count Dooku}}</ref> to many in the Parliament, Dooku did not hesitate to override the assembly's decisions without its knowledge, including the proposal for peace that Mina Bonteri introduced. He sought to keep the war going so that it could fulfill<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> the Sith Grand Plan,<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> to ultimately bleed the Republic dry to the point that the Sith could claim it.<ref name="NEC" /> He thus manipulated the Confederacy and its Parliament on multiple occasions,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /><ref name="A Friend in Need" /> even engineering the demise of members of the Parliament&mdash;such as Mina Bonteri and Bec Lawise&mdash;as he saw fit,<ref name="A Friend in Need" /><ref name="Crisis at the Heart" /> while also enlisting ruthless enforcers such as General Grievous<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /><ref name="NEC" /> and the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]] to carry out his agenda of deception and manipulation.<ref name="Jedi: Count Dooku">''[[Jedi: Count Dooku]]''</ref>

===Mina Bonteri===
{{Quote|How many lives on ''both'' sides have to end before we see the ''futility''? Surely there's room in the galaxy for Confederate and Republic planets to coexist. I move that we immediately open peace negotiations with Chancellor Palpatine on Coruscant.|Mina Bonteri|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />}}
{{Main|Mina Bonteri/Legends}}
[[File:MinaBonteriHS-SWE.png|thumb|right|120px|Mina Bonteri]]
A prominent senator of the Separatist Parliament, Mina Bonteri represented her homeworld of Onderon.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mina" /> Initially a member of the Republic Senate, Bonteri came to disagree with the Republic's direction and withdrew<ref name="Encyclopedia: Confederacy">{{SWE|groups|separatists|Separatist Alliance}}</ref> alongside her homeworld,<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mina" /> which Onderonian [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sanjay Rash/Legends|Sanjay Rash]] [[Treaty of Iziz|allied]] to the Confederacy at the outset of the war.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Saw">{{SWE|characters|sawgerrera|Saw Gerrera}}</ref> In leaving the Senate, she forsook a number of connections and close friendships. Yet unlike other more aggressive Separatists, Bonteri had no inclination to pursue conquest or warfare,<ref name="Encyclopedia: Confederacy" /> instead believing in ending the war through diplomacy.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mina" /> She admired Count Dooku as a political leader,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> though she, like many other Separatist citizens, remained unaware of the atrocities being committed in their name on the battlefield.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Mina" />

A respected example of Separatist idealism,<ref name="Encyclopedia: Confederacy" /> she championed coexistence between Republic and Confederate worlds as a solution to the fighting. When an old friend, Padmé Amidala, came to Raxus Secundus to pursue a peaceful resolution to the war, Bonteri collaborated with her former colleague to open negotiations with the Republic, proposing a bill to the Parliament calling for an immediate end to the conflict. While the majority of her associates voted with her,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> Dooku had her murdered to derail the peace effort and further his own wartime agenda.<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need" /><ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> Her position in the Parliament was filled by her son, Lux Bonteri, who uncovered Dooku's complicity in her death and sought to avenge her.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Lux" />

===Bec Lawise===
{{Quote|That is a lie! Remove this traitor immediately.|Bec Lawise, on Lux Bonteri|<ref name="A Friend in Need" />}}
{{Main|Bec Lawise/Legends}}
[[File:Bec_Lawise-FinN.png|thumb|right|120px|Bec Lawise]]
Senator Bec Lawise served as the Separatist Congress Leader, presiding over Parliament sessions<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> alongside the Head of State.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> As speaker of the Parliament,<ref name="Explore: Crisis at the Heart" /> he was a firm supporter of Count Dooku, refusing without a second thought to believe allegations of Dooku's crimes. Lawise was one of several congresspeople who petitioned the Republic to acknowledge the Confederacy as a legitimate government, a move that the Republic delegation hesitated to make at the peace conference on Mandalore. He was irked by Lux Bonteri's uninvited appearance at the negotiations and was quick to label him as a Separatist traitor for his charges levied against Dooku. He immediately responded to Bonteri's words with force, not hesitating to have the young man taken into custody despite the clear prospect of Dooku having him executed for his accusations.<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> Nevertheless, Lawise ultimately proved expendable to Dooku, who engineered Lawise's death when the senator raised objections to his arrest of Padmé Amidala on Scipio, as part of a plot to wrest control of the banks from the InterGalactic Banking Clan.<ref name="Crisis at the Heart" />

===Voe Atell===
{{Quote|The Corporate Alliance will never allow this to happen.|Voe Atell, in response to Mina Bonteri's bill for peace|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />}}
{{Main|Voe Atell/Legends}}
[[File:Voe_Atell.png|thumb|right|120px|Voe Atell]]
A senator affiliated with the Corporate Alliance, Voe Atell spoke for the commerce guild at times in the Separatist Parliament. During the debate over Mina Bonteri's bill to initiate diplomatic negotiations with the Republic, Atell took a stand against her pro-peace colleague, going so far as to swear that the Corporate Alliance would never permit a Parliament decision to end the war. Some of her fellow delegates took umbrage at her remarks, with Kerch Kushi likening her Corporate Alliance ties to the seats that such megacorporations held in the Republic Senate. Atell voted against the bill for peace, though she ended up being in the outvoted minority. Although opposed to negotiations with the Republic on that occasion,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> she accepted afterward a place on the three-member Parliament delegation at the Mandalore peace conference, where she pushed for recognition of the Confederacy's legitimacy. Padmé Amidala was reluctant to meet her demands, and the discussions later collapsed.<ref name="A Friend in Need" />

===Lux Bonteri===
{{Quote|I stand before you, son of Mina Bonteri, loyal Separatist, a patriot, a friend.|Lux Bonteri|<ref name="A Friend in Need" />}}
{{Main|Lux Bonteri/Legends}}
[[File:LuxBonteri-SWE.png|thumb|right|120px|Lux Bonteri]]
The son of Mina Bonteri, Lux Bonteri continued his mother's representation of Onderon in the Separatist Parliament following her death.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Lux" /> Having grown up as a Separatist,<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> Bonteri was idealistic from a young age, sharing some of his mother's views about the futility of war.<ref name="Encyclopedia: Lux" /> He was eventually orphaned by the Clone Wars: his [[Mina Bonteri's husband/Legends|father]], a military [[Officer/Legends|officer]], was [[Battle on Aargonar|killed]] in the line of duty,<ref name="A Friend in Need" /> while his mother died for her ideals,<ref name="Encyclopedia: Confederacy" /> as Count Dooku arranged.<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need" /> Although Bonteri saw himself as a patriot and loyal Separatist, he renounced his Confederate ties and resigned his Parliament seat after discovering Dooku's actions. He cautioned other senators about Dooku, believing that he would one [[Standard day/Legends|day]] betray them just like he had with Mina. Bonteri resolved to bring Dooku to justice, withdrawing to support the Mandalorian [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], a splinter group of terrorists, in its hunt for Dooku. As part of his plan, he interrupted the peace conference on Mandalore to publicly accuse Dooku of murder, so that he would be brought to the count and be able to [[Holotrace device/Legends|pinpoint]] his exact location for the Death Watch.<ref name="A Friend in Need" />

Bonteri later joined a [[Onderon rebels/Legends|resistance movement]] on Onderon<ref name="A War on Two Fronts">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref> and helped to [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|liberate]] his homeworld from Separatist control, following which he was reappointed as the senator of Onderon given his brief tenure in the Parliament. He decided that Onderon's best course of action would be realignment with the Republic, intending to follow in his mother's footsteps by joining the Republic Senate.<ref name="Tipping Points">{{TCW|Tipping Points}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|That all needs to come to light with Nute Gunray, Wat Tambor, San Hill, Passel Argente, all those guys, and explaining who the Separatist Council is that you see in the films, versus the Separatist Senate, versus the Trade Federation and the guilds&mdash;the Commerce Guild, the Trade Federation, the Techno Union.|Series Supervising Director Dave Filoni, on the introduction of the Separatist Parliament|<ref name="Umbara Commentary">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Four|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Four]], "Darkened World of Umbara" Commentary</ref>}}
[[File:SeparatistSenate4-HOBS.png|thumb|left|250px|The Separatist Parliament represented a retcon to the Confederacy's government.]]
The Separatist Parliament was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series as the civilian government of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> First alluded to at [[Celebration V]] in [[August]] [[2010]] by Series Supervising Director [[Dave Filoni]],<ref name="Season Three Revealed">{{SWArchive|url=fans/events/clone_wars_season_3_revealed/index.html|text=''The Clone Wars'': Season Three Revealed}}</ref> it was mentioned in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] episode "[[Supply Lines]]" in [[September]] 2010, with the episode's [https://web.archive.org/web/20101129172327/http://starwars.com/theclonewars/guide/episode303.html accompanying guide] on [[StarWars.com]] identifying it as a civilian-based section of the Confederate government.<ref name="Supply Lines Ep Guide" /> The Parliament was introduced in "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]," which was released on [[November 19]], 2010. In addition to the prominently featured Mina Bonteri, several other senators were identified in the episode's [https://web.archive.org/web/20110629044901/http://www.starwars.com/theclonewars/guide/episode310.html online guide].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" /> The Parliament also played a role in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] episode "[[A Friend in Need]]," in which a delegation from the Parliament was portrayed taking part in an unprecedented peace conference with the Republic. The episode aired on [[January 13]], [[2012]].<ref name="Explore: A Friend in Need" />

The Parliament represented a [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] regarding the government of the Confederacy, which had&mdash;up until the Parliament's introduction&mdash;only consisted of the corporate-based Separatist Council.<ref name="CSWE: Separatist Council" /> The Parliament's exact relationship with the Council has yet to be clarified, though the television series had previously referred to the existence of the Council in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]].<ref name="Dooku Captured">{{TCW|Dooku Captured}}</ref> According to Filoni, Series Producer [[George Lucas]] saw that the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] mistakenly portrayed the Separatist Council as the government of the Confederacy, as well as the Trade Federation's allegedly clear Separatist ties. Lucas dictated that megacorporations like the Trade Federation, Commerce Guild, and others on the Separatist Council were more of a neutral party during the events of ''The Clone Wars'' series, with the Parliament being the Confederacy's true civilian government.<ref name="Umbara Commentary" /> The ineffectiveness of the Parliament, which was implied through Count Dooku's machinations in "Heroes on Both Sides,"<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" /> was acknowledged in the [[April]] 2012 ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', which also tied it into the formation of the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="Warfare" /> One of the book's co-authors, [[Jason Fry]], commented that he made a point to compare the Rebels to the earlier Separatists, incorporating the Parliament when the opportunity presented itself.<ref name="Warfare Endnotes 9">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/23995413972/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-9|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 9}}</ref>

According to Series Writer [[Brent Friedman]], the Parliament would have been featured in a future story arc of the television series, though those episodes were never produced<ref name="Friedman Twitter Parliament">{{Twitter|BFree63|status/464637770422812673|[[Brent Friedman]]|quote=Good question. I seem to recall their presence in at least one planned arc.}}</ref> after the series was removed from being broadcast in [[March]] [[2013]].<ref name="New Direction">{{SW|url=news/a-new-direction-for-lucasfilm-animation|text=A New Direction for Lucasfilm Animation}}</ref>
